page.overview:
Who is Duala?

was a young woman with scrying abilities. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Duala is young mousy woman of red-brown skin. Her eyes are snow-blind. She has big black curls that trail down to her middle back.

After Vox Machina cleared out the platinum mine, Korshad called on Duala to confirm that all conditions were met. She cast a spell similar to scrying to verify that job had been done.
